ops.vehicleRules: Under the Hotel Regulations, parking in front of the front entrance is strictly prohibited and the underground parking must be used. Vehicles parked outside the space designated by hotel staff will be towed, and the cost is borne by the user.
ops.parking: Public parking beneath the hotel (B2F to B3F), 172 spaces. Vehicle limits on B2F are 2.1 m in height, 5 m in length and 2 m in width. Rates are 660 yen for 1 hour and 1,320 yen for 2 hours (tax included). Only one entry and exit is allowed. Reservations are not accepted; the lot can normally be used without one.
ops.waitingRooms: There are men's and women's changing rooms on the 4F. The small venues Aegean, Caribbean, Pacific, Adriatic, Amstel and Atlantic can also be used as waiting rooms. Time Nest (5F) and Trinity (6F) have permanently installed furniture and sofas and can be used as VIP waiting rooms or as a space for pre-dinner drinks. The living room (anteroom, 126m²) of Harbor View Terrace can be used as a waiting room or as a space for pre-dinner drinks.
ops.catering: Banquet cuisine is French for both standing and seated service, and Japanese and Chinese arrangements are also accepted for standing receptions. There is an off-site catering service in which the hotel's kitchen goes to a designated venue; fees for travel, transport and setup are available on inquiry. The Hotel Regulations list bringing in food and drinks from outside the hotel as something guests are asked to refrain from.
ops.restaurants: The restaurants and bars in the hotel are Zillion, La Provence, New York Lounge and Teppan-Yaki TAKUMI on the 1F, Chef's Live Kitchen on the 3F, and MANHATTAN on the 6F. Banquet plans include the Executive Meeting Plans for meetings, and the Executive Party Plan, with a choice of a standing buffet (15,000 yen per person) or a seated dinner (20,000 yen per person).
